fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-07-10, the complainant received an SMS with a link resembling a bank notification; after entering card details on the page, Rs. 4,800 was debited. The time of the incident was given as 01:45 on 2025-07-10. The online submission was made by Babu Selvam (9000000442). Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100001. The complainant alleged that Rakesh Gopal may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000405. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00115, as the mobile number 9000000405 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent KYC-update message allegedly used to collect account credentials.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, suspect, night, mobile number, shopping complex, receiving account
